This is my small maize plot, only a quarter of my land, so I must care for it well because maize feeds my family. I will buy a little fertilizer from the cooperative — maybe one small bag of DAP and some urea if I can afford it — because without fertilizer the soil here is tired and the maize will not give enough. I keep a few animals, so I will also spread manure on this plot before planting, as my mother always did. I cannot afford improved seed or pesticide this year, and I have no way to bring water, so I will use my own saved seed and pray for good rains. I will do most of the work myself — weeding, planting, harvesting — and ask my neighbors for help only at harvest if needed.
